categories.main_business_segments: Ventas operates through three primary business segments: (1) triple-net leased properties, which includes senior housing and healthcare facilities leased to operators under long-term leases; (2) the Senior Housing Operating Portfolio (SHOP), where Ventas owns senior housing communities operated by third-party managers; and (3) office operations, which includes medical office buildings (MOBs) and life science, research, and innovation centers. The company also has a third-party institutional capital management business, Ventas Investment Management (VIM).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Ventas' core business is the acquisition, ownership, development, leasing, and management of healthcare real estate assets. The company leverages real estate investment, property management, and asset management expertise, including the use of triple-net leases, RIDEA structures for SHOP, and joint ventures for capital management. Advanced building systems are used in life science centers, and the company employs technology platforms for property management and reporting.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Ventas primarily serves healthcare operating companies, senior housing operators, health systems, universities, and life science/biotech tenants. Its end markets include senior living (independent, assisted, memory care), medical office, life sciences, hospitals, rehabilitation, and skilled nursing. Major customers include Brookdale Senior Living, Ardent Health Partners, Kindred Healthcare, Atria Senior Living, and Sunrise Senior Living.
categories.geographic_coverage: Ventas' portfolio is geographically diversified across the United States (with properties in 47 states and D.C.), Canada (seven provinces), and the United Kingdom. California is the only state representing more than 10% of total revenues and NOI. The company also has a presence in major metropolitan areas and university/medical campuses.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ventas operates as a downstream participant in the healthcare real estate supply chain, acting as a property owner, landlord, and asset manager. It provides facilities and capital to healthcare operators and tenants, enabling their delivery of healthcare and senior living services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, Ventas focuses on generating reliable and growing cash flows, maintaining a diversified and high-quality asset portfolio, and preserving financial strength and liquidity. The company emphasizes growth through acquisitions, development, and redevelopment, as well as ESG leadership and innovation in property management. R&D is centered on real estate development, operational efficiency, and leveraging technology in property and asset management.
categories.revenue_model: Ventas generates revenue primarily through rental income from triple-net leases, resident fees and services in its SHOP segment, and rental income from office properties. Additional revenue streams include management fees from third-party capital management, interest from loans and investments, and promote revenue from joint ventures. The company also earns gains from property sales and equity investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Ventas competes with public, private, and non-listed healthcare REITs, real estate partnerships, healthcare providers, lenders, developers, banks, insurance companies, pension funds, and private equity firms. Major competitors include Welltower, Healthpeak Properties, and other large healthcare REITs. Ventas is positioned as one of the largest and most diversified healthcare REITs, with a strong presence in senior housing, medical office, and life science real estate.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2022, Ventas owned or had investments in approximately 1,300 properties with total assets of $24.2 billion and annual revenues of $4.1 billion. The company has a large, diversified portfolio and significant liquidity ($2.4 billion at year-end 2022). Growth in 2022 was driven by acquisitions, development, and recovery in the senior housing segment, though the company faced headwinds from COVID-19 and macroeconomic pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Ventas offers a unique value proposition through its scale, diversification across asset types and geographies, and expertise in healthcare real estate. The company emphasizes reliable and growing cash flows, a balanced and high-quality portfolio, and strong relationships with leading healthcare operators. Its integrated approach to ESG, innovation in property management, and ability to partner with institutional capital further differentiate Ventas in the market.
